title: Daily Quiz
summary: Build a multiple-choice quiz with your own questions that scores answers.

expect.fail: Drag the Header tool onto the glowing Header zone.

steps.title: Write your first question
steps.objective: Add a question with its answers.
steps.concept: ADD QUESTION takes the question, then ANSWER and the correct answer, then OR and the wrong answers. The correct answer always goes first, and the studio shuffles them when the quiz runs.

cmds: ADD QUESTION "What is 2 + 3?" ANSWER "5" OR "4" OR "6"

expect.label: The quiz has at least 1 question

hints: Write the question, then the correct answer, then wrong answers separated by OR.
Every part goes inside quotation marks.
Copy the command from the step card exactly, then press Run Commands.

steps.title: Add two more questions
steps.objective: Build a quiz with three questions.
steps.concept: More questions make the quiz more useful. Use subjects your classmates are studying.

cmds: ADD QUESTION "Capital of Saudi Arabia?" ANSWER "Riyadh" OR "Jeddah" OR "Dammam"
ADD QUESTION "How many days in a week?" ANSWER "7" OR "5" OR "6"

expect.label: The quiz has at least 3 questions

hints: Two ADD QUESTION lines, one per line.
Put the text inside straight quotation marks.
Copy the command from the step card exactly, then press Run Commands.

steps.expected: You finish the quiz and see a score.

hints: Press Run Project and watch the demo.
Tap Start Quiz, then tap an answer for each question.
After the last question press See my score.

objectives: Write your own quiz questions with a right answer and wrong answers.
Run the quiz with shuffled answers and a score.
Save quiz scores so other parts of the app can use them.

mcqs.q: Why does a quiz shuffle the order of the answers?
a: So the right answer is not always in the same place
mcqs.why: Shuffling stops students from memorising a position.

mcqs.q: What does the score do while the quiz runs?
a: It counts the correct answers so far
mcqs.why: A running total is updated after every question.

mcqs.q: What does a loop do in the quiz?
a: Repeats the same steps for each question until none are left
mcqs.why: Loops let one set of instructions handle many questions.

mcqs.q: Why show the correct answer after a wrong choice?
mcqs.why: Feedback turns a mistake into learning.

mcqs.q: Why test a quiz with both correct and wrong answers?
a: To check that both paths work
mcqs.why: Good testing covers every decision in the flow.
